title: Chapter 99 — CRM Leverage & The Analyst Sessions
intro: Friction-free capture, file synthesis, and pattern-mining sessions.

sections.title: Friction-Free Capture
sections.content:
The CRM only works if you use it. The biggest barrier to CRM adoption is friction — too many fields, too many clicks, too much time. Reduce the friction.

After every customer interaction, spend 60 seconds logging: customer name, what they are looking for, what you showed them, their main concern, and the next step. That is five fields. Sixty seconds. Do it immediately — not at the end of the day when you have forgotten half the details.

sections.title: Pattern Mining
sections.content:
Once a month, sit down with your CRM data and look for patterns. Which quote stage has the highest drop-off? If 40 percent of your quotes stall at the 'spouse consultation' stage, your bridge materials need upgrading.

Which product categories have the highest close rate? If you close 35 percent on dishwashers but only 18 percent on ranges, your range demo or discovery needs work.

Which follow-up method converts best? If phone calls convert at 3x the rate of emails, make more calls.

The CRM is not an admin tool. It is a coaching tool. The patterns are telling you exactly where to focus your improvement efforts.

sections.title: The Weekly Analyst Session
sections.content:
Spend 15 minutes every Monday reviewing your pipeline with AI assistance. Upload your open quotes and ask: which quotes are most likely to close this week? Which ones are going stale? Which customers have not been contacted in 14 or more days?

The AI sees patterns you miss because it processes the entire pipeline at once. You see the customer relationships and the contextual factors the AI cannot. Together, you make better decisions about where to spend your time.
